name: 7-Eleven Run 2026
short_description: A 5km and 10km road race at Marina Barrage, Singapore, on 23 August 2026.
ai_summary: The 7-Eleven Run 2026 is a road race held at Marina Barrage in Singapore, offering runners a choice between a 5km and a 10km distance. Taking place on 23 August 2026, it gives participants the option to pick a shorter or longer route depending on their training goals and experience level.
pros: Choice of two distances (5km and 10km) to suit different fitness levels
Scenic waterfront venue at Marina Barrage

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the 7-Eleven Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The 7-Eleven Run 2026 offers two distance options for participants: a 5km race and a 10km race. This gives runners the flexibility to choose a shorter route if they are newer to running or a longer one if they want more of a challenge on race day.

faqs.question: Where does the 7-Eleven Run 2026 take place?
faqs.answer: The race is held at Marina Barrage in Singapore, a waterfront venue in the city. Runners taking part in either the 5km or 10km distance will start and finish their race at this location on the day of the event.

faqs.question: When is the 7-Eleven Run 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The 7-Eleven Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on 23 August 2026. It is set in Singapore at Marina Barrage, giving participants a full day to complete either the 5km or 10km distance on offer.
